name: Veille arctique
historicalBrief: Sniper Wolf MGS1 conserve cheveux, visage, yeux et silhouette; surcouche thermique vert olive, coutures réparées, sac de rations et masque respiratoire porté au cou. La lunette et le fusil restent de son époque.

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. SNIPER WOLF, Metal Gear Solid 1 incarnation, adult fair-skinned woman with the exact long pale ash-blonde hair and fringe, sharp green eyes, slim athletic build and serious expression of the attached first figure. Costume OC-001 Veille arctique: a fully closed olive thermal over-jacket with a high collar and padded shoulders, obvious hand-repaired seams and a short worn field capelet integrated into the jacket; trousers retain Wolf knee protection and high black lace-up boots. A small respirator hangs AT HER NECK so her face stays uncovered; two functional filters visible below the collar. Add a compact worn ration satchel at rear hip and a rolled thermal mat above it. Keep her period black PSG1 precision rifle, long narrow barrel and correct scope, held safely across the body pointing right with both hands. Her face, hair and recognisable MGS1 silhouette must remain hers. Different from the old generic torn suit/gasmask look: visibly insulated complete jacket and neck-hanging respirator. No cleavage or bare abdomen. Clean weathering, no injury.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
Faithfulness of identity is based on physically viewed preserved CQC incarnation references; no pixel-perfect Konami model certification.
No left-facing draw, animation continuity, hitboxes or playable admission delivered by this source.
